AxSecurityPrivilege.Name: HSMobileOpsPostLogView
AxSecurityPrivilege.Label: View mobile posting log
AxSecurityPrivilege.HelpText: Read what has posted from a handheld - which order, which device, when - without being able to change or delete any of it. No dedicated form of its own: this table is read through OData/reporting and through the other screens that already carry it (HSMobileOpsUser), not a standalone page in D365FO.
